name: Markdown TOC Generator
summary: Generate a Markdown table of contents with anchor links from heading lines.
description: Paste a Markdown document and get a nested table of contents with GitHub-style anchor slugs. Choose bullet or numbered lists and filter by heading level. Headings inside fenced code blocks are ignored.

faqs.question: Which heading syntax is supported?
faqs.answer: Standard ATX headings (# through ######) on their own line.

faqs.question: How are anchor slugs built?
faqs.answer: Lowercase text, spaces become hyphens, and duplicate titles get -1, -2 suffixes — similar to GitHub.

faqs.question: Can I limit which headings appear?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set minimum and maximum heading levels (H1–H6) in the options.
